---
title: "JAX-MPPI"
---

## Overview

A JAX-native implementation of Model Predictive Path Integral (MPPI) control variants with built-in autotuning capabilities. Leverages JAX's JIT compilation and automatic differentiation for efficient GPU-accelerated trajectory optimization.

## Tech Stack

- **Language:** Python
- **Framework:** JAX
- **Methods:** MPPI variants, autotuning
